text_block_list.text:
"Tracen volunteers are putting on a live DJ show!"
Invited by the flyer, I headed over to the venue—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Way-waaaay☆
What's up, peepsss?!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: YEEEEAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Much love, all good, vibe check passed! Let's crank the vibes to insane levels! Say ho-oh☆

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: HOOO-OH!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You can go way louder than that, ho-oh!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: HOOO-OH!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! As expected of Helios!
Hyped up the whole place in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real, before it started there were so many smug folks acting all 'let's see what a bunch of students can even do'.
choice_data_list: It's so incredible, it puts adults to shame!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right on, how d'ya like that! Well, this is just the warm-up though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Watching DJ Helios up close from behind the stage is really the best seat in the house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san, wanna take a look too?
At the "other side of the sun".

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, Jordan, good work, good work~☆
Gonna take a 10-minute break!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, even the Academy Trainer-san is here!
What's up? Thinkin' of switchin' careers to DJing??

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, just wanted to check out backstage.
Don't mind them, go ahead and rest.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thaaanks! Ah, gonna switch up the second half mix!
Like boom-boom, chill~, rat-a-tat, BOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, if it's all BOOM, they'll burn out, right??
So chill~ then rat-a-tat makes the BOOOOM hit crazy hard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... the crowd's getting tired,
so she wants to slip in a chill track
to save up for the final hype climax, right?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like anyone could ever guess that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Clap! Clap!
One more clap☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mm, the back's droppin' a bit.
Time to――

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And now into the――chill! Super emotional, right?
One of my fav tracks too☆

The atmosphere in the venue shifted instantly with the track.
Lured by the gentle melody,
the audience began to relax as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you mean her skill at hyping the crowd?
Or how closely she watches the audience?
choice_data_list: Both, but especially how serious she is

text_block_list.text:
The serious expression she showed in unexpected moments,
her steady gaze fixed on the turntable.
It was a side of her you could only see from behind the scenes, and I couldn't look away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Pretty cool, right? That Helios.
My heart totally skipped a beat the first time I saw it.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real, that gap is insane.
She takes her DJing crazy seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because Helios is 100% committed
to both the crowd and her DJing,
she puts on such an amazing show.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, last one! Higher, higher!
Put your hands uuuuup☆
choice_data_list: (To think she had a side like that...)

text_block_list.text:
It was a vivid, unforgettable DJ performance
that completely transformed my impression of Daitaku Helios.
